fixed_ports.eyes_itemport: PU_Head_Eyes_White_CharacterCustomizer (no geometry: eyes come from the face library, colour from EyeMaterial)

headwear_rule.tags: T = union over worn items of {hairTag (if set)} + addsTags + {"maskFacialHair" if maskFacialHair}
headwear_rule.hide: a .chf port is hidden when a worn item hiddenParts entry maps to it (hidden_parts table); hiding wins
headwear_rule.hair: hair_itemport: the first of ["snoopy_cap", "hatHair_mask", "hatHair"] that is in T and in the item's headwear; else the base geometry
headwear_rule.facial_hair: beard_itemport / stubble_itemport: "maskFacialHair" in T and in the item's headwear -> that variant; else base
headwear_rule.materials: variants keep the base item's port dye parameters; templates by the variant's own .mtl sub-materials; snoopy_cap is cloth (fixed colour)
headwear_rule.fit: items with fit "face_wrap" (Char_Clothing_Hat: hats, caps, bandanas, masks) are bound to the blended face like the hair: per vertex the 4 nearest protos head vertices (inverse-square, 0.5 mm floor), pos += sum w * (blended - protos); helmets and hooded torso items stay rigid (clearance; their hair is snoopy_cap or hidden)
